يختطفوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَطِفُوا (yaḵtaṭifū) /jax.ta.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# يُخْتَطَفُوا (yuḵtaṭafū) /jux.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
